notes.title: We've updated the demo! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Thank you for your feedback[/h2]

Thanks to your amazing feedback through Steam Discussions and Discord, we realized there were a few important things missing from the demo — and we’ve been working hard to bring them in as quickly as possible. One of the most requested features was the ability to ​​automatically save your progress​​, and we’re happy to say: it’s finally here! 😊

We were genuinely touched to see how many of you wanted to spend more time in the game — it means the world to us.

But that’s not all! Here’s a full list of what’s new and improved: ​

[h2]📝 Changelog:[/h2]

•   Implemented the ​​automatic save system​​ (thanks to everyone who pointed this out on the forum!)
•   Added a ​​sharpening effect​​ – the game should now look less blurry
•   Fixed ​​gobold spawn issues​​, including a bug that caused empty fights (also reported on the forum)
•   Improved and polished the ​​quest log
•   Increased the size of ​​consumable item counters​​ on the bottom left of the exploration screen
•   In combat, the lower number now shows the ​​maximum healable value​​ instead of max HP – this should make it easier to see who can still be healed (forum feedback!)
•   Fixed an issue where the ​​formation setup would reset​​ – it should now stay as you set it (thanks again, forum!)
•   Added a ​​camera reset​​ option – just press ​​Z
•   Visual improvements to trees – birchbark is now less bright, and we reduced flickering
•   Fixed various ​​typos
•   Save settings (volume, graphics, etc.) should now ​​persist between sessions​​ instead of resetting (forum feedback!)
•   Added a few ​​extra hints​​ to help you out
•   The ​​first-time demo popup​​ no longer says saving isn’t available
•   Plus many other ​​small tweaks, fixes, and optimizations 

[h2]📽️ And one more thing[/h2]

We’ve prepared a short ​​video​​ where we talk about what makes our game special and how it stands out. We’d love for you to check it out!

[previewyoutube=r4nnvynvbBc;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think, and as always – thank you for playing and supporting us! 💚

/Sigilfarer Team

Stay tuned for more insights into the strategic depth of ​Sigilfarer​! Follow us on [url=https://x.com/AnsharPublish][b]X[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/sMFWjmWvaU][b]join our Discord community[/b][/url] to learn more about the game and share your adventures with others 💙

notes.title: Embrace the Challenge: Sigilfarer's Roguelite Adventure Awaits!
notes.content:
[b]Sigilfarer[/b] invites you to dive into the excitement of the unknown with its Roguelite gameplay. Here, [b]every time you fail, you get a chance to become stronger.[/b] Each new adventure is a fresh start in a world that keeps changing, full of new challenges and ways to grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/7be3d43f5acf8b50f8b49272e231ea4480f9fd1e.png[/img]

In Sigilfarer, failing isn't the end—it's just a way to come back better. Every time you play, you can [b]unlock new perks [/b]that make you stronger and[b] improve your gear [/b]for the next adventure. The map changes every time, so no two games are the same, giving you [b]a new experience each time you play.[/b]

As you explore, you'll find [b]new quests and surprises.[/b] These events, based on your choices, can help you or give you new challenges, adding a fun twist to your journey. 

With changing maps, new quests, and choices that affect the game, [b]Sigilfarer is fun to play over and over. [/b]Even if a game is short, you'll have hours of fun exploring its world. Play the demo to try it out for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/95e49ea9bc6acb600307df48967e5ca8d4c0d33c.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates on Sigilfarer's exciting features. Follow us on [url=https://x.com/AnsharPublish][b]X[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/sMFWjmWvaU][b]join our Discord community[/b][/url] to learn more about the game and share your adventures with others. Your journey in this Roguelite world is just starting, and many adventures are waiting for you!

notes.title: How Does Inventory Affect Your Character's Abilities?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e847c7691828d1a88204e3c34f0a5ce5fb910810.png[/img]

[h3]As we journey through the captivating world of Sigilfarer, it's essential to understand one of the most critical aspects of our adventure:[b] the character inventory[/b]. [/h3]

The inventory isn't just a storage bag—[b]it's an intricate system that shapes our abilities in battle, [/b]determining success or failure in every encounter.

[b]In Sigilfarer, the items our characters wear directly influence their abilities during combat. [/b]Let's explore this further by taking a closer look at our trusted Warrior. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/7b4decd08e2414980a1d7e7490351e98eae2a1ec.jpg[/img]

Equipped with a [b]sword[/b] and a [b]shield[/b], we can see these items showcased at the [b]bottom of the screen. [/b]Each item isn’t just for decoration; these objects translate into our Warrior's arsenal of abilities visible on the[b] left side of the screen[/b]. For example,[b] the sword grants our Warrior an attack[/b], dealing 3 damage. Meanwhile, [b]the shield not only defends him, but also provides a valuable ability to protect both him and his allies.[/b]

It's important to remember that characters can only equip items [b]meant for their specific class.[/b] For instance, our Druid cannot wield the Warrior's hefty sword and shield, just as our Warrior can't adorn the Druid's magical gear. This brings us to our dear Druid. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/45707c452486afc98346ea1cd87d14a63cf64270.png[/img]

Currently, the Druid's equipment enables him to heal an ally or the entire party. Yet, he holds a saber in his backpack. If we chose to equip it, our Druid could embrace the dark art of [b]Vampirism[/b], an [b]ability dealing damage to foes while simultaneously replenishing his own vitality.[/b]

Let's take a moment to appreciate the Druid's [b]spear[/b]—a weapon occupying two slots. In contrast, the saber requires just one hand. Imagine replacing those healing abilities; we trade 8 HP heal to an ally and a 3 HP group healing capability for a fearsome 12 damage strike that concurrently heals our Druid with 6 HP. That switch frees up a slot - this could be a good thing (place for another item) or bad a bad one (chance to roll a blank).

We must keep in mind that there are [b]six slots available[/b] for these abilities because [b]we roll a d6 to select our move.[/b] No one wants to roll a blank and be left stranded without an action! 

By mastering our inventory, we unleash our character's true potential. So, dear adventurers, explore the myriad of possibilities, plan your arsenal, and let your inventory be the source of your characters' strength! 💪

May good fortune shine upon you ⭐
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/83b775c6bc0a1457406a3cf9f27857398b810f60.png[/img]

notes.title: From Gloom to Glow: The Visual Transformation of Sigilfarer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e847c7691828d1a88204e3c34f0a5ce5fb910810.png[/img]

[h3]We are thrilled to share with you the incredible journey Sigilfarer has undergone over the past few months! As we set sail on this adventure, our goal was to breathe [b]new life [/b]into the world you know, making it [b]more [/b][b]vibrant [/b]and [b]captivating [/b]than ever before.[/h3]

[h3][b]A World Reimagined[/b][/h3]
When we first embarked on this voyage, Sigilfarer was cloaked in shadows, with a [b]heavy [/b]and [b]dark [/b]atmosphere that, while intriguing, didn't fully capture the [b]magic we envisioned[/b]. We decided it was time for a change, to steer our ship towards a more [b]colourful [/b]and[b] lively world[/b]. 

[h3][b]The Colours of Adventure[/b][/h3]
Our first port of call was the palette. We infused the world with a burst of colours, painting the landscapes with [b]rich, vibrant hues[/b]. The once sombre forests now glow with life. Every corner of Sigilfarer now feels like a fresh,[b] new adventure waiting to be explored[/b].

[i][b]Before:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/71367ac6bd713ebec98c6412a64ca0110ad1000f.png[/img]
[i][b]After:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/ad3804be7cd51756e5b96e2001d0a924eb7b2de9.png[/img]

[i][b]Before:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/8a109f73b0b2b5775baa2c25f50b29fa3d3a4b0d.png[/img]
[i][b]After:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e2fd50e003299f65119d608268ed5ba2366c7e45.png[/img]

[h3][b]Reflecting Beauty[/b][/h3]
One of the most enchanting changes we've made is to the bodies of water. We've added highly [b]reflective surfaces[/b] that mirror the beauty of the world around them. We also turned our attention to the [b]user interface[/b], giving it a bit of a makeover. The new UI will not only be [b]more intuitive[/b] but also [b]more visually appealing[/b], making your journey through Sigilfarer [b]smoother and more enjoyable.[/b]

[i][b]Before:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/0d01eab40963d4fdae827d70b101f0dbabb62293.png[/img]
[i][b]After:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/d2f0fb399ad6c73cb79f825935c1ed8c0ab1c7d4.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy these changes as much as we enjoyed making them! Sigilfarer is now a brighter, more enchanting place, and we can't wait for you to experience it for yourself. Here's to new adventures and the endless wonders that await!

May good fortune shine upon you ⭐
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/83b775c6bc0a1457406a3cf9f27857398b810f60.png[/img]
